headline: Sensex plunges 989 points, Nifty slips below 25,650 as bears take charge led by IT stocks and HDFC Bank

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex tumbled 989 points and Nifty slipped below 25,650 on November 27 as bears took charge of the market.
Drag in major IT stocks and HDFC Bank drove benchmark indices sharply lower.
India bonds slumped as a spike in crude oil prices added to bets of an RBI rate hike.
India's forex reserves dropped $4.44 billion to $700.90 billion due to gold losses.
whatHappening: Bears tightened grip on the stock market as Sensex sank 989 points and Nifty closed near 25,600.
RBI lowered the CRR maintenance requirement for banks back to 90% starting December 1.
BPCL commissioned an integrated lube blending plant and base oil terminal in Maharashtra.
TVS Motor entered the cargo tricycle market with Armado, eyeing international sales.
summary: Indian benchmark indices suffered a sharp drop on November 27, with the Sensex crashing 989 points and Nifty slipping below 25,650. Heavy selling in IT stocks and HDFC Bank along with bond market pressure dragged equities lower. Key stock updates included BPCL opening a new lube blending facility and TVS Motor launching its Armado cargo tricycle.
